remarks: Welcome to effortless luxury at The Buckingham-where style, comfort, and convenience come together beautifully. This sun-drenched, meticulously maintained 1BR + den offers ultimate flexibility. The spacious den easily functions as a true second bedroom, home office, or guest retreat-ideal for today's work-from-home lifestyle. Step inside and be greeted by abundant natural light streaming through oversized windows. The open floor plan showcases an updated chef's kitchen with sleek countertops, modern appliances, and a generous island perfect for meal prep and casual dining. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area and expansive living room, creating an inviting space for relaxation and effortless entertaining. Your private balcony beckons for morning coffee, evening cocktails, and breathtaking sunset views-a rare find at this price point. The spacious primary bedroom boast a double closet with ample storage, while the oversized spa-inspired bathroom impresses with custom cabinetry and a luxurious walk-in tub/shower designed for comfort and accessibility. In-unit washer and dryer. Resort-style amenities include: 24-hour concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, sauna, sparkling outdoor pool, library/conference room, and vibrant community lounge with full kitchen. One deeded garage parking space and private storage unit included. Walk to shopping, dining, entertainment, library, Metro North. Move-in ready and waiting for you. Owner absorbed assessment.
